reviews.title: Beautiful App💗 but accessibility barrier for dyslexia
reviews.body:
I really love using Glorify - the daily devotionals, prayers, and overall design are wonderful for building a regular routine. However, there is a major accessibility issue that needs to be addressed. As someone with dyslexia, reading large blocks of text is a significant barrier, yet the audio-listening feature is locked behind the paid subscription.

While I understand monetizing premium content, basic audio playback is essential assistive technology for neurodivergent and visually impaired users. Connecting with God shouldn't be harder or more expensive just because of a learning disability. I truly hope the developers consider making basic audio narration free so the app can be accessible to everyone in the community.

reviews.body:

The bad are: 
1) Reports of scammers to the Developer, who are blatantly victimizing desperate people , go unheeded. Emails to them go unanswered and people continue to be robbed. Christian sites are prime target for scammers and identity thieves, people are trusting, many are young and too many people believe everyone else there is a Christian with morals. A small group is trying to warn others of the predators, but people still report being victimized. If the developers would ban them, this wouldn't happen. I hope they realize they're liable for failure to act on reports of thieves.

2) There's no instructions on use, rules of conduct, how to report, or repercussions for those who rob or abuse others on this Christian site. 

3) Reports of members posts, who are abusive to others and use profanity, including F bombs, also go unheeded, and they are allowed to continue. Many have left due to how offensive some insist on being and are allowed to continue to. 
It's becoming more like certain social media sites every day, where people forget where they are and why they are there.

I was at the end of answering a persons question, when a pop-up interrupted, telling me an update is available. I refuse to write that message for a third time!  If you run out of alloted characters when pasting scripture to a comment, instead of letting you know, it deletes your entire message and closes the app!!

reviews.title: Glorify’s Business Practices
reviews.body:
Glorify started as a wonderful app that seemed to really prioritize the message of God. The call to all believers is to go forth and make disciples, and this app was doing a phenomenal job of building an intentional, daily opportunity to engage with God and grow fellow believers in Christ. However, over the years, they’ve continually drawn back on free features and now there is not much left to do at all unless you are a paid subscriber. The nature of the app itself has now changed, and what should be free for all to experience and learn in Christ is now paywalled. 

I don’t believe that there’s anything wrong with having paid features in an app, but ALL of these features started off as free, it’s astonishing to see they’ve left little unpaid now. I’m very disheartened to say that I will now be uninstalling the app. I do not wish to support a company that has changed to view believers and their faith as business models. An app now only useful for those willing to pay.

reviews.title: Good but priced out
reviews.body:
Using Glorify now feels a bit like looking at a car I once drove and loved every day — only to find it’s been priced out of reach. I used to rely on this app regularly and found so much value in its simplicity and daily encouragement. But now, with the shift to a $70 USD annual subscription, it feels like something meant for everyone has become exclusive.

There was a time when, if you wanted a devotional, you’d walk into a Christian bookstore and pick up a book or CD. You’d pay maybe $25 to $75 and have something forever— no ongoing payments, no subscriptions. Glorify, while it does offer much more in terms of content that’s being updated, now over five years would cost $350 USD! That’s a big ask, especially when many of us won’t use even half of what’s included.

I get that apps cost money to build and maintain, and I don’t expect everything to be free. But I wish there were more flexible options — like a one-time purchase or a more affordable tier — especially for longtime users who were around when the app felt more like a ministry than a product.

So for now, I’m going back to reading the Word the old-fashioned way — so honestly, can’t say I’m not thankful for what it did for me in the end.

reviews.body:

The app was a top fave among my morning apps. Now it's laborious and lengthy, with too much added in that is really not an enhancement. It was simplistic and got the job done. There's too much packed in now. Not well executed. Needs tweaking.

This app in its original form was awesome. It was very educational and a great start to the day. All of a sudden, it got buggy in September. It wrongly stopped my streak, which I was very proud of. Then came the update. The update has taken all of the app's uniqueness away. I enjoyed the content and took pride in seeing my tree grow. Everything that made the app so good has been taken away or watered down. Please bring the thoughts of the day from behind the pay wall.

Horrible update. Used 2b my favorite app. Greed get to this app creator too? It used 2b a great (free) tool to know Lord Yeshua (Jesus). Now 99% is locked, the VR walk is off-putting. Jesus said "you have freely received, freely give." SO MANY HAVE HATED THE UPDATE BUT WILL YOU LISTEN TO YOUR AUDIENCE? I'd listen to those expressing concerns, most just uninstall & go. I pray Our Lord blesses you in a way that allows you to freely bring people to Him again. 🙏God Bless🙏

I found this app this summer and I loved it! Such a pitty that they tried to fix what was not broken. I liked the system they had before this daily walk business (quote, passage, devotional, and prayer). I felt it targeted all the areas I needed to work on (the word and prayer). I especially loved the prayer portion because other apps don't focus on that. I also really enjoyed that as an added bonus you had the opportunity to choose a testimony or story from the library for free. Now it's all $$

reviews.title: Please bring back the daily devotionals!
reviews.body: I love the app, but I really miss reading the daily devotionals as they were always so well written and easy to understand. The audio ‘daily walk with God’ is still nice, but the daily devotionals were better and more user friendly.

reviews.title: please change it back
reviews.body: i used to really love this app for how it focused on exploring scripture, which helped me with my walk a lot, and helped me start the day with a new perspective. but this new structure isn’t helpful at all; the daily walk and bible verse doesn’t even link in the same sort of message which prevents me from having a focused start on my day. i really don’t find the daily walk personal or consisting of any of the things you claim it has been created for. i miss the old structure and hope you listen to the other reviews to change it back.

reviews.title: Not to be dramatic but change it back…
reviews.body: I have enjoyed using this app immensely. It has really helped me get back into reading my bible and I have even recommended it to friends and family however, the most recent update is not good. Please listen to everyone’s feedback and change it. I’m really disappointed with this new format.

reviews.title: I have a problem with the “New Update”
reviews.body:
Glorify is great worship and praise app but I noticed that they changed the layout, and I have a problem with that.

 The daily devotional and passages that we would receive in the old version is gone(you can still go back to them when going back in the calendar ) but that’s besides the point, the old version always made me motivated to read the word of God because the layout was easy and I didn’t have trouble picking a passage since it was chosen for me and you get to have a week dedicated to a certain topic.

While on the new update it’s very limited because we just get, walk with God,prayer and verse of the day and no topic we focus on the week.This is really disappointing since this is my favourite and first Bible app I have, Team Glorify if you see this may you please bring back the old version and make some audios in the mind free certain times during the week like you guys usually did.

Thank you for reading this, I hope you guys listen to the responds and if you do I would rate this app a 5/5 😊

reviews.title: New Update
reviews.body: This was my fav app. But after the new update I’m not liking it as much. Some of us don’t get the chance to listen and it’s better for us to read.

reviews.title: The new update is not good
reviews.body:
I loved Glorify. I used it at a time in my life where I struggled reading the word and I struggled with prayer. I loved how Bible centred the daily prayer was.

I have got the new update and I would say I dislike it greatly. It reminds me of a mindfulness app rather than an app for prayer. Although outwardly similar, these two practices are pretty different. 

Before the daily focus had more biblical quotes, whereas now, 6 minutes is devoted to what seems like mindfulness and meditation and a very short time of reflecting on God for who He is. There is a lot of reflection about ourselves that has its place but I feel the app has got the ratio wrong. 

Unfortunately an app I loved because of how distinct it was and caused me to reflect on God’s goodness is no longer distinct, and points to extended self reflection like many other apps.

reviews.title: Unhappy with recent update
reviews.body: Before the newest update, my rating would’ve been 4.8, to how much I enjoyed the devotionals. Though, I like the new walk with God feature, I don’t like that there is no longer a passage to read and background context that goes with it. The walk with god devotional, the verse and the prayer now feel like all separate things. Before this update, the quote, passage, verse and prayer were all a cohesive devotional experience. It was very enriching and I am terribly disappointed with the new setup. Should the walk with god devotion have a matching passage that it takes inspiration from and perhaps a quote again, and ofc prayer, it would improve the quality of my devotions again. The context from the passages was also really enlightening! Now it is just singular verses that don’t compliment the other pieces as well. I had shared this app with so many people just because of how spiritually edifying it was. It doesn’t feel like that anymore. I hope this reaches someone who had the power to make changes. Thank you for all you do!

reviews.title: Please return to previous version.
reviews.body: I’ve loved turning to this app every morning however, I really don’t like this new version. The strange scene takes your mind off of what is being said and there are only snippets of scripture thrown it. No scripture focus. Also, the main theme appears not to be in sync with the daily scripture or reflection either. Such a shame to change things. It worked before.

reviews.title: I used to enjoy this app…
reviews.body: They’ve taken away the daily devotional, the quotes and scriptures of the day and replaced it with a “walk with Jesus” that’s no where near as informative or enjoyable to use. I used to enjoy reading the devotional but now you can only listen. Glorify haven’t been helpful at all in restoring the app and now I’ve noticed all my free downloads are locked and you now get NO access to free content from the app other than the daily walk. This has been a huge step backwards on an app that used to be brilliant. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Massive change
reviews.body: I’ve had this app for a few years now and I loved it as it was a way for someone like me who isn’t well versed on the bible and doesnt have a deep understanding of it to read the scriptures and learn from the bible study that was presented directly after. That’s all gone now and has been replaced by a daily verse and meditation podcasts, and I am now really struggling to find a reason to keep this app. Very disappointing

reviews.title: I used to love this app but….
reviews.body:
Last update doesn’t have a daily scripture, instead it has a guided meditation and a single verse of the day. I used to love that I could read a complete bible story, and the context of each biblical book in a different format. Reading the bible directly instead of a guided meditation gave me the opportunity to read with new eyes, but now it is just a single verse. I won’t recommend this app anymore, we need more scripture, not less. For meditation I loved the additional resources, the stretches, the extra goal every day… now it is all gone. 

 Previous review: I looove this app, it has helped me develop a daily discipline to read the scripture and pray daily.

reviews.title: Used to be my favourite app
reviews.body: Not a fan of the daily walk update as I prefer to read actual passages from the bible and the devotional was very helpful for me personally.

reviews.body: Seems great, but does not have King James Version. Other than that great app, would totally recommend if there was KJV

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: For an app that represents God I’m very disappointed with the falsehood. It asked me to send 5 invitations to get 1 year free. And of course, when my last invitation used the link I provided and signed up, I didn’t get the one year free. When I tried to get help, the service turned around and blamed it on my last invite and said they didn’t use the link. But they did. When I tried to communicate this to them, they haven’t responded since. My point: they didn’t live up to their end of the deal. Well I found this app inspiring with the little time I used it, I will not pay for it. Jesus can be found for free!

reviews.title: Struggling to find content that’s not paid
reviews.body: Had high hopes for the app andI am very aware of the commercial challenges and the fiscal responsibility of running an app like this. You can’t really assess the quality of the app without paying- yet that’s what the Freemium model is designed to do. Looks great, feels great but it would be good to see the quality of content before subscribing.

reviews.title: Warning: Uses the NIV only for the daily passage part!
reviews.body: The app generally overall functions well and has nice features except that the daily passage part of the app is in the NIV translation only where God and Jesus in some parts are referred to in lower case letters, for example did a study today and the daily passage was John 8:29-36 and God was referred to as “him” and not Him and when Jesus was referred to it was “me” instead of Me. It would be greatly appreciated if the app allowed one to change the Bible translation for the daily passage part instead of having to use the NIV translation which does not appear to revere God or Jesus.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.body:
Once you download the app, they let you listen to just 1 daily devotional. Then they ask you to subscribe to Glorify plus. On day 2, you can’t listen to any devotionals until you subscribe.
You can only access general information.
2)9.99 per month for daily devotional is crazy. 
I appreciate the efforts of the people doing this but i don’t think it is right to make money from preaching the word of God. Even if you have to, 9.99$ per month is expensive.
3) put the price in your description so that people are fully aware before downloading 
Thanks.

reviews.title: Loved… but now deleting
reviews.body:
Update: 17 July 2021

Really gutted to wake up and open the app to a screen that forces me to pay up or miss out. No heads up from Glorify … just bam. At £43 a year there are other apps. I guess you decided to monetise because you did a great job but I don’t like the way you implemented your new premium feature without warning. I’ll be deleting the app now you’ve managed it all wrong. I saw someone else comment on not being able to afford the fees, Holy Trinity Brompton’s Bible in a year is a fantastic free devotional for those who can’t afford this sort of premium. 

For those who are willing to pay, my previous review is below. I can’t comment on whether it’s still accurate due to being locked out of Glorify unless I pay up immediately. 🙄

I love, love, love this app. It is the first one that I have enjoyed and use frequently. I tell everyone about it. You can read or listen to the daily devotion; I love to listen.
